name: LiteLLM MCP Gateway
summary: The LiteLLM Proxy's MCP Gateway gives one fixed endpoint for MCP tools, controls access by key and team, and lets any LiteLLM-supported model call them.
description: Supports HTTP, SSE and stdio MCP servers, OAuth and per-server auth headers, converting OpenAPI specs into MCP servers, and a REST API (`/mcp-rest/tools/list`, `/mcp-rest/tools/call`). The repo LICENSE is MIT except for the `enterprise/` directory, which has its own license. Latest release v1.106.2 (2026-10-21).
